name: tinyxml2
description: Vendored copy of leethomason/tinyxml2, restricted to the library sources. Upstream ships contrib/html5-printer.cpp with its own main(), which the Arduino core does not define; the linker resolves crt0's main from it and pulls in libstdc++ iostream/locale with it (~5.7 kB DRAM on classic ESP32). srcFilter excludes contrib/ and test/ so only tinyxml2.cpp is built.
